billing_notes: Official public text, image, video, voice and tool pricing, including prompt-length rules and regional/batch modifiers. Account-authenticated model pricing is not collected without a separate reviewed source.
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: * **Cached prompt tokens**: Prompt tokens that were served from cache rather than recomputed
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: * **Completion tokens**: The final response
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: * **Image tokens**: Visual content analysis (when applicable)
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: * **Input tokens**: Your query and conversation history
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: * **Reasoning tokens**: Agent's internal thinking and planning

https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: *Prices shown per million tokens. Models listed with two rows use long context pricing: requests whose prompt reaches the listed token threshold are billed at the higher rate for all tokens in the request.*

https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: > The batch discount applies to text and language models only. Image and video generation are supported in the Batch API but are billed at standard rates. See [Batch API documentation](/developers/advanced-api-usage/batch-api) for full details.
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: All prices are in USD. For per-model details, see the [models page](/developers/models).
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: All standard token types are billed for the model used in the request:
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: Downloading data from files and collections is charged at a flat rate based on the amount of data transferred:
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: Files and collections stored on the SpaceXAI platform are billed based on the amount of storage used.
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: For Remote MCP tools, you will not be charged for the tool invocation but will be charged for any tokens used.

https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: For `grok-4.7` this is $2.20 / $0.55 / $6.60 per 1M tokens (input / cached input / output) below 200k prompt tokens, and $4.40 / $1.10 / $13.20 above. The 1.1x multiplier applies to input, output, and cached input tokens, including long-context rates. [Prompt caching](/developers/advanced-api-usage/prompt-caching) discounts are applied before the multiplier. See the [Regional Endpoints documentation](/developers/advanced-api-usage/regions) for the scope of the US processing and storage guarantee.
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: For how the **bills are charged**, visit [Manage Billing](/console/billing) for more information.

https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: For the most up-to-date information on **your team's model availability**, visit [Models Page](https://console.x.ai/team/default/models?utm_source=docs\&utm_medium=referral\&utm_campaign=developers-pricing\&utm_content=models) on xAI Console.

https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: For the view image and view x video tools, you will not be charged for the tool invocation itself but will be charged for the image tokens used to process the image or video.
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: For violations that are caught before generation in the Responses API, we will charge a $0.05 usage guideline violation fee per request.

https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: Grok 4.7 Fast is the same Grok 4.7 model served on faster infrastructure. It costs 2x the standard token rates, or 1.5x for long-context requests. It's available only in [Cursor](https://cursor.com) and [Grok Build](/build/overview), and is billed through your plan there. It is not available on the public xAI API, and Grok Build's free tier does not include it.
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: Image Search is part of Web Search and is billed at the standard Web Search rate.
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: Long-context rates apply once a request's prompt exceeds 200k tokens. Cursor bills its own fast variant through your Cursor plan.
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: Models not listed above have no batch discount.

https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: Requests sent to the [US regional endpoint](/developers/advanced-api-usage/regions), `https://us.api.x.ai/v1`, run inference in the United States; their token usage is billed at **1.1x** the global token rates, a 10% premium.

https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: Requests which make use of SpaceXAI provided [server-side tools](/developers/tools/overview) are priced based on two components: **token usage** and **server-side tool invocations**. Since the agent autonomously decides how many tools to call, costs scale with query complexity.

https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: The 2x multiplier applies to all token types — input, output, cached, and reasoning. [Prompt caching](/developers/advanced-api-usage/prompt-caching) discounts are applied before the multiplier.

https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: The [Batch API](/developers/advanced-api-usage/batch-api) lets you process large volumes of requests asynchronously at a discount to standard pricing. The size of the discount varies by model. Batch requests are queued and processed in the background, with most completing within 24 hours.
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: The batch discount applies to all token types — input tokens, output tokens, cached tokens, and reasoning tokens. Batch discounts by model:
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: To see a model's resulting batch prices, toggle **"Show batch API pricing"** on its detail page. Models that accept Batch with no discount show N/A.
https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: When your request is deemed to be in violation of our usage guideline by our system, we will still charge for the generation of the request.

https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: X Search is billed per item fetched rather than per call: every post returned by a search or thread fetch, including parent and quoted posts, counts toward the post rate, and every profile returned by a user search counts toward the profile rate.

https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: You are only billed at the priority rate when the response confirms `"service_tier": "priority"`. If the request is served at the default tier instead, standard rates apply.

https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: You can view and manage your [files](https://console.x.ai/team/default/files?utm_source=docs\&utm_medium=referral\&utm_campaign=developers-pricing\&utm_content=files) and [collections](https://console.x.ai/team/default/collections?utm_source=docs\&utm_medium=referral\&utm_campaign=developers-pricing\&utm_content=collections) through the xAI console or the [xAI API](/developers/files/managing-files).

https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing: [Priority Processing](/developers/advanced-api-usage/priority-processing) gives text requests higher scheduling priority for lower latency. Priority requests are billed at a **2x** premium over standard rates.
